attribution_limitations: The Day 1 summary row reports cardiac catheterization with normal coronaries, while the case text reports a coronary angiogram with patent stents and non-obstructive CAD in a patient with prior three-vessel stenting. The source does not say these are the same procedure, so the differing descriptions are an ambiguity, not a source conflict of one value.

The case-text TTE (IVSd 14 mm, unchanged from prior TTEs) and the Day 1 summary-row echocardiogram (14 mm maximum septal diameter), and the case-text cMRI (IVSd up to 18 mm, mid-myocardial LGE) and the Day 2 summary-row cMRI (18 mm maximum septal diameter, septal LGE), may describe the same studies, but the source never identifies them as the same measurement or time point; they are kept as separate items.

"for 4 days" follows a list of palpitations, presyncope and intermittent chest pain; the source does not say whether it applies to each symptom, so the duration is recorded only on the adjacent intermittent chest pain.

The summary-figure rows are labelled Day 1, Day 2 and Day 5 without a named anchor, and later rows say 3 months later, 4 months later and 1 year later; the anchor of those labels is not stated in the row text.

The 25 mmHg LVOT gradient on echocardiography and the 45 mmHg invasive post-PVC gradient were measured differently; the case states it was suspected the true gradient was significantly higher, which is hedged and not recorded as a fact.

The Day 2 summary row says the cMRI combined with the ECG "localized VT focus to hypertrophic septum", while the abstract, introduction and discussion state the focus only as suspected or a belief; the electrophysiology mapping study was bypassed.
